scope: Autonomous local simulation using the production ranker and sanitized live demo profiles. Synthetic responses are not real technician acceptance or message delivery.

snapshot.source: Sanitized live demo profiles and routing policy. Auth IDs replaced with presence marker. No customer data.

checks.name: All ten actual demo profiles validate
1 Milford: travel with equal business inputs
2 Hopkinton: nearest technician is off shift
3 Holliston: spring specialty beats proximity
4 Franklin: closest technician is at capacity
5 Foxborough: out-of-area work is held
6 Medfield: business value outweighs idle alternative
7 Natick: equal business inputs favor lower workload
declined: do not repeat offer to same technician
expired: do not repeat offer to same technician
cancelled: do not repeat offer to same technician

Unknown service holds safely

Past appointment holds safely
Account access revoked excludes matching technician
Invalid existing reservation excludes technician
Nonpositive contribution blocks all technicians
Demo and real teams stay isolated in both directions
Every technician can be independently evaluated with explicitly synthetic coverage
Next-week balance counts the service week, not today’s week
This-week work does not distort next-week balance
Cancelled and deleted work does not consume capacity or balance
Historical successes and failures change a future recommendation
History older than 90 days is ignored
Void/deleted invoices never improve learned revenue
252 service/ZIP/window combinations satisfy feasibility and deterministic ordering
1,000 seeded varied schedules respect availability, capacity and exclusions
Forty sequential synthetic requests never overbook; surplus stays held
